verdict.line: You lose trades to Kled's mounted Q-into-E burst before you've stacked armor, but the lane equalizes the moment Skaarl dismounts and your kit starts scaling.

brief.thesis: Kled's Skaarl mount is effectively a second health bar that keeps him dealing full damage to champions while his Q (Bear Trap on a Rope, 11-7s CD, 800 range) hooks you into his E (Jousting, 13-9s CD, 550 range) for a burst combo your early kit can't out-trade. Malphite's identity — Granite Shield and an E that scales its damage off your armor — doesn't punish anything until you actually have armor items, so the first several levels are genuinely his. The one guaranteed equalizer is the moment Skaarl's mount health empties: Kled dismounts and deals reduced damage to champions until his courage meter refills, which is when Malphite's base stats and a landed E/Q combo can flip a trade he started.

theirWindow.when: Kled mounted with Q and E up
theirWindow.what: He can hook you with Q then follow with E (Jousting, dash with a recast dash-back) for a full burst combo. Back off rather than trading into it — don't give him a free Skaarl-fueled all-in.

yourWindow.what: Kled dismounts and deals reduced damage to champions until his courage meter refills. Flip aggression immediately with E Ground Slam and Q Seismic Shard before he can rebuild courage and remount.

powerCurve.note: Skaarl's HP buffer still absorbs your pokes
R unlocks mutual engage, armor starts stacking
Armor-scaled E and Thornmail punish his autos
Unstoppable Force chains teamfights, Kled falls off

start.why: The most-picked start in this matchup (61.7% pick rate) — the mana regen keeps you spamming E Ground Slam and Q Seismic Shard to poke him off mounted range instead of trading autos into his W Violent Tendencies.

boots.why: The standard pick here (83.3% pick, 42.9% win rate) — flat physical damage reduction cuts down his autos and his empowered 4th hit under Violent Tendencies.

core.why: First item in the strongest measured path (75% win rate over 8 games) — immediate health and armor that both blunts his autos and feeds E's armor-scaling damage.
Second item in that same path — more armor for E, plus thorns/grievous wounds that punish an auto-attack-reliant matchup.
Closes out the top measured build — more armor for E scaling plus attack speed reduction that further dulls his Violent Tendencies windows.

situational.when: the enemy team adds burst magic damage alongside Kled
you need an early armor and health rush before your first full item completes
you're ahead and want to convert your armor stacking into more magic damage output instead of pure tank stats

runes.keystoneWhy: The Resolve page (44.7% pick, most common) gives sustained health growth to outlast his hook/joust trades and scales your max health into E's armor-based damage; master-tier Malphite players instead run Arcane Comet (Sorcery, 42.2% pick in that bracket) for a harder poke-first lane if you're confident winning the early trades yourself.

summoners.why: The standard pick here (44.5% win rate, 85% pick rate) — Teleport lets you reset back to lane after losing early trades to his mounted burst and still scale into the matchup's late-game advantage. Flash+Ignite (41.2%, 12.1% pick) is the alternative if you'd rather punish him immediately after he dismounts instead of playing the long game.

playing.title: Dodge the hook
playing.detail: Respect Q's 800 range whenever it's up — getting hooked yanks you straight into his E Jousting follow-up for a combo you can't escape mid-animation.

playing.title: All-in after dismount
playing.detail: The moment Skaarl's health bar empties, Kled deals reduced damage to champions until courage refills — this is your window to commit, not his.

playing.title: Trade with E, not autos
playing.detail: E Ground Slam (7s CD) deals magic damage off your armor and cuts his attack speed, directly countering his W Violent Tendencies steroid.

playing.title: Hold W for commitments
playing.detail: Save W Brutal Strikes (14s CD) for when he actually dashes in with E rather than poking from range — you want the armor/AD buff active when he's in melee range.

playing.title: Protect your Granite Shield
playing.detail: Granite Shield only recharges if you haven't been hit recently — disengage from his chip damage so it's up when he commits his real Q+E all-in.

playing.title: Stack armor before fighting
playing.detail: Every armor item (Sunfire Aegis, Thornmail, Frozen Heart) directly raises E's damage — your poke only starts punishing him once you're two items deep.

playing.title: Punish his charge with R
playing.detail: Unstoppable Force is on a long 130-80s cooldown — don't burn it chasing a joust reset; save it to collapse on him after he's committed Chaaaaaaaarge!!! elsewhere.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and win rates are measured from real games on the current patch (16.20.1) via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning behind why each choice works is my own read of the kit interactions, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid Kled’s (Q) to have the upper hand! Try to nuke him after he dismounts Skaal!
